about_the_game:
Raveren: The Legend of Etheria

A dark fantasy RPG where memory is your greatest weapon—and your deepest curse.

Centuries ago, the world of Etheria was torn apart by The Sundering, a failed magical ritual that unleashed Raveren—a cosmic entity of entropy that devours reality itself. Now, the land is fractured, corrupted by the Aether-Rot: a creeping decay that erodes stone, warps life, and steals memory.

You are Kaelen (or Lyra), a lone wanderer gifted with Aether-Sense—an uncanny ability to perceive magic and its corruption. While others forget, you remember everything. Haunted by loss and driven by a need for truth, you uncover a forgotten Memory-Core Shard deep beneath the ruins of the Sunken Spires. What you learn could unravel the world—or save it.

Explore a shattered realm where factions clash over survival and ideology:

  • ⚔️ Ironhold: Militaristic survivors who reject magic.

  • 🌿 Whisperwood Enclaves: Druids fighting to heal the land.

  • 📚 Scholars of Dust: Mages chasing forbidden knowledge.

  • 🛖 Nomadic Tribes: Scavengers living on the edge of madness.

Master the lost language of Proto-Arcana, uncover ancient truths, and shape the fate of Elteria. But beware—Raveren is still feeding, and your memories may be the final course.

Features:

  • 🧠 Narrative-driven exploration with memory-based mechanics

  • 🧭 Dynamic Aether-Sense gameplay: detect corruption, uncover secrets

  • 🧙‍♂️ Faction-based choices and branching storylines

  • 🏞️ Atmospheric environments warped by the Aether-Rot

  • 📖 Discover and wield Proto-Arcana to reshape realit

short_description: Raveren: The Legend of Etheria is a dark fantasy epic set in a broken world unraveling under the weight of its forgotten past. Once a realm of radiant magic and harmony, Elteria was shattered by The Sundering—a catastrophic event not born of war or nature, but a tear in reality itself.
